run_inference_on_image_pairs: run inference on a list of image pairs using a dust3r model with configurable batch size
compute_loss_of_one_batch: compute the loss for a single batch of image pairs through a model with optional symmetric batching
extract_predicted_3d_points: extract predicted 3D points from model predictions using depth, pseudo_focal, or direct pts3d output
find_optimal_scaling_between_pointclouds: find the optimal scaling factor between ground truth and predicted point clouds using avg, median, or weiszfeld methods
check_image_pairs_same_size: check if all image pairs in a list have the same spatial dimensions for batch processing
